title: Low-speed comfort and low-noise impressions
summary: The topic centers on low-speed drivability, comfort, noise, and perceived quality, but many fragments are too brief or ambiguous to support a clear sentiment reading.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise low stress comfort, low cabin noise, stability, and strong low-speed torque.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe discomfort or jerkiness at low speeds, especially in ride quality and transmission behavior.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention low quality, low noise, roof height, and low-speed smoothness, but the excerpts are too incomplete or context-limited for reliable sentiment assignment.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are incomplete, highly compressed, or lack enough context to determine whether the mention is praise, criticism, or description.
The cluster mixes several subjects, including low-speed behavior, cabin noise, interior or key quality, and physical height or roofline, so it is not a single tightly focused theme.
One positive-labeled fragment contains clearly negative wording, so example-level label consistency appears imperfect.
